claim_one_line: FRAME C'S CUSP EXPONENTS ARE THE CENSUS LINES' AND ITS AVERAGE TAKES THEIR MINIMA (PROVED at leading order, data-free): at each of the 24 points of order 5 frame C's mass ratios fall as exact powers of |q| that depend only on the point's first coordinate, every cell of both generations given by B1788's closed form 1/2 - (||2 q_L a|| + ||2 q_R a||)/2 and its tropical rule (192 cells within 1.2e-3; B1659's determinant law holds on frame C to 1.8e-30), the slope-2/5 points W178's tuple (3/10, 4/5, 1/5, 11/20), so the exact weight and Theorem 90 do not move them; the averaged read-out's rates are the minima over the points (up 1/10 and 1/2, down 1/5 and 11/20 or 1/2), a pattern that mixes points and that no single census line has; the Higgs triplet is itself hierarchical in steps of q^(1/4). B1944's pointer to a cusp-weighted read-out is corrected: the single lines' cusp limits (W178) and the best single tau on the order-5 lines (B1698) were already tried and failed. 0 of 19.
